function.description: This API allows the user to get an AnchorGroup by AnchorGroup ID
function.name: api_getAnchorGroupByID

anchorGroupName.description: Anchor Group Name. Max length is 32 characters

anchorPriority.description: This indicates anchor priority.  Priority values range from 1 (high) to 3 (low). Primary, secondary or tertiary and defined priority is displayed with guest anchor. Only one priority value is allowed per anchor WLC.

ipAddress.description: This indicates Mobility public IP address

macAddress.description: Peer Device mobility MAC address. Allowed formats are:0a0b.0c01.0211, 0a0b0c010211, 0a:0b:0c:01:02:11

managedAnchorWlc.description: This indicates whether the Wireless LAN Controller supporting Anchor is managed by the Network Controller or not. True means this is managed by Network Controller.

mobilityGroupName.description: Peer Device mobility group Name. Must be alphanumeric without {!,<,space,?/'} and maximum of 31 characters.

peerDeviceType.description: Indicates peer device mobility belongs to AireOS or IOS-XE family.

privateIp.description: This indicates private management IP address
